messages:
maria_support: Hey @alex_cs — escalating a live issue for ACME Corp (premium trial). Since ~11:05 UTC embeds for their ingestion pipeline started failing with 503/timeouts. They have renewal review next Tue. Need CS to triage for renewal risk. :warning:

maria_support: Quick context — error rate jumped from 0.2% to ~8% for embed requests, p50 latency spiked from 120ms -> 1.2s. Affected region: us-west1. Sample log:
```
2026-03-20T11:05:12Z request_id=abc123 model=embed-v1 status=503 reason=capacity_exhausted
2026-03-20T11:05:18Z request_id=abc128 model=embed-v1 status=504 reason=upstream_timeout
```
Link to support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8421

alex_cs: Thanks Maria — marking this P0 for CS. Can you confirm whether the customer is hitting our hosted endpoint or a Dedicated reservation? Also: any recent config changes on their side?

maria_support: Hosted endpoint. No recent customer changes reported; they just increased batch size in their pipeline earlier today but said it passed local tests. I can post full KPI graphs in a sec.

kevin_prodops: I see elevated GPU utilization in the us-west1 embed pool starting 11:00 UTC. Autoscaler tried to add nodes but hit soft limits due to concurrent reserved builds. I can do a targeted burst (add +2 nodes) and route a fraction of traffic to us-central1 as a short-term mitigation. Will need approval for immediate burst.

priya_enablement: If we schedule an enablement sync today we should capture the customer's batch config and recommend safe batch/timeout defaults. Suggest a 30-min call before the renewal. I can run a replay session with them and capture feedback to feed product.

maria_support: Customer is on a 7-day eval, renewal call on 2026-03-24. They said they're blocked from ingesting new content now. Pointed them to a grace queue but they want real throughput.

tom_account_manager: Hold renewal outreach until we stabilize. If we can offer a one-week extension or a small credit that's low-friction. I'll draft language once we know fix ETA. Assign owners?

alex_cs: Owners and immediate plan:
- maria_support: primary comms with customer (post updates every hour).
- kevin_prodops: enact burst + partial routing fallback (ETA 15-30m).
- priya_enablement: schedule 30-min technical enablement + feedback capture (ETA today).
- tom_account_manager: hold renewal, prep extension/credit offer.

alex_cs: Timeline: 15m triage, 1h mitigation (reroute/autoscale), 4h for stable workaround or escalation to infra. If unresolved after 4h we'll initiate a dedicated trial offer.

deploy-bot: autoscale: triggered autoscale-policy-embed-usw -> adding 2 nodes (node-set id: ns-58c) — started at 2026-03-20T11:20:03Z

kevin_prodops: Implemented a canary routing rule to send 30% of embed traffic to us-central1 while nodes come up. Config snippet:```
route {
  if region == "us-west1" && model == "embed-v1" {
    fallback_region = "us-central1"
    fallback_weight = 0.3
  }
}``` This should reduce immediate pressure and lower 503s. Monitoring CPU/GPU and error budget now.

maria_support: Updated customer: told them we pushed a mitigation and will monitor. They're relieved and agreed to a 2pm PST call (2026-03-20T14:00 PST) with Priya.

priya_enablement: Booked 30-min slot with ACME for 14:00 PST. Agenda: reproduce at their scale, safe defaults (batch size, timeouts), and a short walkthrough of our observability. I'll capture feedback checklist and share notes.

tom_account_manager: Drafted renewal note: pause renewal conversation; offer 10% trial credit + 1-week extension if we miss SLA in next 72h. Approving language now.

alex_cs: Please capture customer feedback in the ticket and add any requests for product changes (eg: autoscaler soft-limit increases, safer default batch throttle). We'll use that for a postmortem.

maria_support: Feedback bullets from the call:
- Customers want clearer guidance on safe batch sizes for embed-v1.
- They expect automatic fallback regions to be visible in console.
- Prefer automatic retry/backoff suggestions in SDK docs.

kevin_prodops: Noted. I'll temporarily raise soft-limit for embed pool and follow up with infra to consider raising default burst quota for hosted customers.

alex_cs: Great. I'll own the postmortem and ensure a short exec summary for CSMs and Sales. Goal: share within 48h.

maria_support: Customer confirmed ingestion resumed and latency improved to p50 ~160ms. They appreciated the quick update. I'll keep hourly check-ins until tomorrow. :thumbsup:
